--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CUST_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CUST_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUST_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT
CUST_ID
,CUST_NUMBER
,CUST_TITLE
,CUST_FIRST_NAME
,CUST_MIDDLE_NAME
,CUST_LAST_NAME
,CUST_CCNY_ID
,CUST_GENDER
,CUST_DOB
,CUST_EMAIL_ADDRESS
,CUST_STATUS
,CUST_WORK_PHONE
,CUST_MOBILE_PHONE
,CUST_DEVICE_ID
,CUST_CCAT_ID
,CUST_NAT_CTY_ISO_ID
,CUST_CUSTOM_DATA
,CUST_CREATED_DATE_TS
,CUST_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,CUST_LIMIT_CONFIG
,CUST_HOME_PHONE
,CUST_CUIT_CODE_1
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1
,CUST_CUIT_CODE_2
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2
,CUST_CUIT_CODE_3
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3
,CUST_ISS_ID
,CUST_RESIDENCE_IND
,CUST_BACKGROUND_IND
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_1_EKY_ID
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_2_EKY_ID
,CUST_IDENT_NUMBER_3_EKY_ID
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CUST_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CUST_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CUSTOMER_WITH_DUP_20240321
